extension.description: Shows a full-screen slideshow of photos from a chosen folder (by default /storage/Slideshow/photos, or a subfolder of it - e.g. one per trip/album - picked via the Photos folder setting). Seconds per photo, random order, background color and photo fit are configured via this addon's own Settings screen. Left/Right on the remote goes to the previous/next photo, Pause/Play pauses and resumes the auto-advance, and Back exits. Photos are scaled per the Photo fit setting against an opaque background, and Kodi's own screensaver is held off while it runs. When Random order is off, photos play in the order they were actually taken (from EXIF date), not filename order. Portrait photos stored sideways with an EXIF rotation tag are automatically corrected (requires Pillow/PIL in Kodi's Python; falls back to showing them as-is otherwise) via a cached copy, without touching the original files. Shows a brief on-screen notification with the running version on startup, handy for confirming an update from the repository took effect. Optionally shows a small caption with the date each photo was taken (from its EXIF data) in the corner of the screen.

extension.summary: Auto-launches TV Slideshow after a period of inactivity
extension.description: Runs quietly in the background. Once nothing has played and there has been no remote input for the number of minutes set in this addon's own Settings screen ("Idle minutes before auto-start") - counted from whichever is more recent, the last remote press or the last time something finished playing - it launches the TV Slideshow addon automatically, screensaver-style, while still leaving Left/Right/Back fully interactive. Does nothing while video/audio is playing or while the slideshow is already running.

extension.summary: Update source for the TV Slideshow addons
extension.description: Installing this once lets Kodi check GitHub directly for updates to TV Slideshow and TV Slideshow Auto-start, showing the normal Kodi "Update" button whenever a new version is pushed - no more manually copying addon folders over for every change.
